lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gills, extending across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, effectively acting as vertical axes for the spot distribution in the mid-body region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from bright highlights on the superior edge to dark shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-15 high-luminance spots, with a higher concentration observed near the anterior base and thinning towards the apex and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated high-luminance objects (likely remoras) clustered ventrally to the primary pectoral fin and along the lower abdominal region.
